title: Your research starts here
description: Prepare market data, develop an idea, and review the evidence before taking the next step.

tutorials.title: 1. Prepare your inputs
tutorials.summary: Start with a clearly defined market and timeframe.
tutorials.body: Open Data Manager to inspect available datasets and their date ranges. Review gaps, timezones and instrument specifications before using data in research. An empty catalog needs data preparation first.

tutorials.title: 2. Describe your idea
tutorials.summary: Make entry, exit and sizing rules explicit.
tutorials.body: Use AlgoWizard to describe a strategy. Record the assumptions behind each rule and the dataset it needs. A workspace preview does not establish that a strategy has been executed or tested.

tutorials.title: 3. Review the evidence
tutorials.summary: Separate a promising idea from a verified result.
tutorials.body: Before accepting results, check the input data, costs, test period and any excluded observations. Compare performance across independent periods. Only treat an operation as complete when its owning workspace reports a real result.

help.title: Working offline
help.body: These text guides are bundled with the application and remain readable while the host is disconnected. Recent projects, About and diagnostics require a host connection. Videos and an online documentation service are not required to read these guides.

help.title: Where are my recent projects?
help.body: Home lists project summaries stored by the host. Browser demonstration projects are not imported into this list. Project cards open the owning workspace; reopening a specific saved project requires support from that workspace.

help.title: Release information
help.body: Choose Check for updates to query the configured application release feed. An unconfigured or unreachable provider is shown explicitly. Checking release notes never installs or downloads an update.
